decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 16th November 2006, the erection of a hip to gable end roof extension measuring 3.3m in width, 3.9m in depth, and 2m in height, and a rear roof extension 5.5m in width, 4m in depth and 2m in height, and for a rear extension measuring 4.1m in width, 2.10m in depth and 2.4m in height, and for the installation of 2 roof lights to the front elevation of the existing house, as shown on drawings 03-01-01, 03-01-05 and 03-01-011, received 13th October 2006, giving a total volume increase of 51.24 cubic metres of which less than 40 cubic metres would be part of the roof, is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed dimensions of the roof and rear extensions and resulting volume is acceptable within the constraints of the relevant classes of the Order.

Condition : 2 - 1. Informatives: If the proposed new rear extension (reference: 00169/22/P1, P/2006/3109) is built prior to the works proposed in this Certificate of Lawfulness, the proposed roof extensions, notwithstanding this Certificate, would no longer be permitted development and planning permission would be required.
2. The submitted drawings do not show the proposed roof lights projecting above the plane of the front roof slope. This decision has been made on this basis.

3.The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a hip to gable end and rear roof extension, including 2 X rooflights to the front elevation of the existing house
